follow-on: the new try/except has no test - nothing raises FlightConfigError, OSError or ValueError through build_record in the suite, so removing the fallback would leave the gate green; a test that submits a malformed catalogue to build_record and asserts the row is still written with lane and model_key unset would cover it.

follow-on: catching ValueError also swallows resolve_name's ambiguity refusal, which is raised as ValueError, so an ambiguous identity silently stores lane and model_key as None instead of surfacing; a probe raising ValueError from the resolver left the pair unset with no error.
